messages:
Maya Kaur: Heads up — planning a small blue->green lane siphon during the 02:00 UTC change window. Target service: router-edge v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0 (config pin + new rate-limiter).
Jordan Lee: ACK. what's the rollout plan? 10/30/60/100?
Maya Kaur: 5/25/50/100 over ~20m with 10m watch windows between steps. Manual hold if p95 increases > 120% or error rate > 3%.
Nina Patel: Copy. Have we pinned sessions? session affinity = cookie-based, will set keep-alive on v2.2.0 to match.
Sam R.: I'll prime caches on the green pool now. Will warm up KV and embeddings caches.
deploy-bot: @channel starting preflight checks: healthchecks ok, certs valid, green pool size 4 nodes ready.
Maya Kaur: NOTE: change-note for SRE/Support -> "router-edge: v2.1.3 -> v2.2.0, enabling token-rate limiter, improved prefix cache". Publish release notes before shift.
Jordan Lee: I'll add a quick smoke test to the pipeline: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://router-edge.internal/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}' | jq .status
```
Sam R.: smoke looks good on a couple of probes. latency p50 ~12ms on green, p95 ~40ms.
Maya Kaur: Ok starting 5% siphon in 2m. @Sam keep an eye on the edge pool metrics, @Nina watch affinity drift.
deploy-bot: Step 1: shifted 5% traffic to green (v2.2.0).
Jordan Lee: :eyes: p95 on prod now 42ms (was 38). error rate steady at 0.4%.
Nina Patel: affinity drift negligible so far. session_count on green: 120 active.
Sam R.: warming: cache hit rate 89% on green.
Maya Kaur: Proceeding to 25% in 8m if metrics stay green. Rollback condition: >3% errors OR any 5m spike in 5xxs.
deploy-bot: Pre-shift metric snapshot stored: run-id=run-1719200000-01.
Jordan Lee: FYI ops channel alerted with release note link.
Sam R.: moving to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Step 2: shifted 25% traffic to green.
Jordan Lee: p95 rose to 60ms transiently then back to 45ms. error rate 0.6% (still within threshold).
Nina Patel: affinity sticky ratio 98% stable.
Maya Kaur: Good. We'll hold 10m. Reminder: if any customer-impacting errors appear, pin traffic back to blue and open rollback.
Sam R.: Watchlist: LB connection errors, quota-denied logs, and regen latency.
deploy-bot: Metric watch: errors=0.7%, p95=47ms, cpu-green=62%.
Maya Kaur: Ready to advance to 50% in 9m. Any objections?
Jordan Lee: No objections. I'll keep test harness running.
Nina Patel: +1.
Sam R.: Advancing to 50%.
deploy-bot: Step 3: shifted 50% traffic to green.
Jordan Lee: small spike in 502s (14 in last 2m) — investigating.
Maya Kaur: Rolling hold — pausing advancement. Sam, can you check connection pools and nginx upstream timeouts?
Sam R.: On it. Quick look: upstream 502s due to a transient memcache flurry during warmup; connections recovered after restart on one node. Restarted node-3, healthchecks passing.
deploy-bot: Node restart recorded run-id=run-1719200000-01-node3-restart. Healthchecks green.
Jordan Lee: 502s back to baseline. error rate now 1.1%. p95 52ms.
Maya Kaur: Given recovery and <rollback threshold, we'll continue but slow: next to 75% then final to 100% with 15m watch.
Sam R.: I'll extend the slow-start timers on the LB to ease ramp.
Nina Patel: Release note updated: added note about memcache warmup and recommended cache priming.
deploy-bot: Step 4: shifted 75% traffic to green.
Jordan Lee: All systems steady. No new 5xx spikes.
Maya Kaur: Final hold 15m then full. If anything looks off, call rollback.
Sam R.: Full 100% now.
deploy-bot: Step 5: shifted 100% traffic to green. All green pool traffic = 100%.
Jordan Lee: p95 48ms, errors 0.9% — within SLOs.
Nina Patel: Session handoff looks good. affinity 99.1%.
Maya Kaur: Closing out: pinned router-edge to v2.2.0 in config-store and pushed release note to ops/support. Creating postmortem marker for the memcache blip (minor).
Sam R.: +1. Will follow up with a short runbook tweak to pre-warm caches before future shifts.
Maya Kaur: Thanks team. Leaving monitoring on midnight watch for next 2h. :coffee:
